title: Development and thermal stability of Cr10Mo25Ta25Ti15V25 refractory high entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting using Compact Arc Melter MAM-1 with granules of Cr (99.9 wt %), Mo (99.95 wt %), Ta (99.9 wt %), Ti (99.99 wt %) and V (99.7 wt %) elements. Before each melting stage, the chamber was vacuumed and flushed with Ar gas at least three times. Produced beads were flipped and remelted at least five times for full mixing and melting of the elements.
